_comment: Parameters for exp_1_separate_fees_lvr. All values referenced from paper equations.
title: Verification of Zero LVR for Separate Fee Mechanisms (Uniswap v3 Type)
paper_reference: Loss-versus-rebalancing with external proportional transaction costs

pool._k_note: Geometric-mean exponent. k=1 is the constant-product (Uniswap v2) reserve curve. Paper eq (17).
pool._C_note: Initial reserve curve level: Y = C * X^(-k). Paper Section 2.1.1.
pool._tau_note: Pool fee fraction (0.3%). Paper eq (1). tau+lambda>0 required by Theorem 3.2.
pool._tau_zero_note: Zero pool fee scenario to verify zero-LVR still holds when lambda>0.

external_market._lambda_note: Proportional external transaction cost parameter. Paper eq (1). lambda in [0,1).
external_market._lambda_zero_note: Zero external cost scenario (used when tau>0).

simulation._N_steps_note: Number of discrete time steps (fine grid approximates continuous dynamics).
simulation._mu_note: Drift of external price GBM (risk-neutral for verification).

deterministic_scenarios.name: monotone_up
deterministic_scenarios._note: Monotone increasing price path. LVR must remain 0.

deterministic_scenarios.name: monotone_down
deterministic_scenarios._note: Monotone decreasing price path. LVR must remain 0.

deterministic_scenarios.name: oscillating
deterministic_scenarios._note: Oscillating price path crossing both boundaries multiple times.

deterministic_scenarios.name: gbm_stochastic
deterministic_scenarios._note: GBM path. Tests zero-LVR for random continuous paths.

parameter_scenarios.name: base_case
parameter_scenarios._note: Both fees positive. tau+lambda>0 confirmed. Paper Theorem 3.2.

parameter_scenarios.name: zero_pool_fee_positive_spread
parameter_scenarios._note: No pool fee, positive external spread. Paper: 'A positive external spread alone suffices'.

parameter_scenarios.name: positive_pool_fee_zero_spread
parameter_scenarios._note: Positive pool fee, no external spread. Standard AMM zero-LVR case.

parameter_scenarios.name: both_positive_large
parameter_scenarios._note: Larger fees for stress testing the zero-LVR result.

acceptance_criteria._note: Max |LVR_tc| / |V_LP| at any step. Should be ~0 (numerical precision only).
Max absolute LVR at terminal time T.
